# tar carries a Debian epoch (1:1.34-6); the purl uses the conventional
# literal-colon version, and the cpe backslash-escapes the epoch colon (a CPE
# field separator) rather than substituting a wildcard.
purl pkg:deb/ubuntu/tar@1:1.34-6?arch=amd64&distro=jammy
cpe  cpe:2.3:o:ubuntu:tar:1\:1.34-6:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
